summary: Enforce least-privilege Gmail MCP OAuth and reject broader authorization grants.
features: Request exactly gmail.readonly and gmail.compose from Google for Gmail MCP.
Show the Google account chooser on every Gmail authorization.
Display the connected Gmail address and granted scope names without exposing credentials.
Replace the recovered Home Assistant Ingress 401 page with an authorization-progress screen.
fixes: Reject and revoke Gmail tokens whose granted scopes are missing, broader than, or different from the allowlist.
Disable incremental authorization so previously granted broad scopes cannot be inherited.
Quarantine previously stored Gmail OAuth records that violate the new scope policy.
Verify the connected Gmail identity through the Gmail profile endpoint before storing credentials.
Preserve customizable Entities columns, Home Assistant priority routing, Shared Files activity acknowledgement, voice behavior, and New Chat reset.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
validation: Exact Gmail OAuth scope allowlist coverage
Unexpected and missing Gmail scope rejection coverage
Stored noncompliant Gmail token quarantine coverage
Google account selection and incremental-scope prevention coverage
Safe Gmail account and scope display coverage
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
